efficiency.default_rule: Default stays fhir until C.1 is met on measured data (Addendum C.4). In addition to section 4 eligibility and release-wide cell-coverage rules, every advertised measured cell used to justify a workflow/type compact default must meet the ≤0.90 point target, be statistically smaller (95% interval upper endpoint <1.0), and pass fidelity, task-success, and mutation gates. Not-smaller, indeterminate, unmeasured, or target-unmet cells retain fhir; preserve structural-projection labels and explicit requested/actual format and fallback disclosures. An unmet C.3 target is reported separately; delivery savings cannot stand in for C.1. The lab recipe is an explicit-format clinical projection; no efficiency claim. The 0.1 gateway runtime default is unchanged by P and any default flip is root integration work.
